title: Client extends DEVAI with the law-pack invariant scaffold
summary: An adopter who has already installed DEVAI (JNY-001) copies the law-pack invariant scaffold into their repo, customizes a subset of cluster-level invariants for their stack, and adds inv-override entries for transitional exceptions. Their substantive invariants now enforce alongside DEVAI's meta-invariants.
preconditions: JNY-001 has been completed; .devai/ scaffold present
Client's domains.json includes the client-side domain codes (STACK, LAYERS, DB, RLS, AUDIT, HTTP, JWT, SESS, RBAC, SECRETS, ENV, TEST, CICD, DOCS, STYLE, AGENT)
Client repo's AGENTS.md (or equivalent authority anchor file) exists at the citation paths the law-pack invariants reference

steps.action: Copy `examples/law-pack/docs/arch/invariants/INV-*.json` into the client repo's docs/arch/invariants/
steps.expected_outcome: 15 cluster-level invariants present: STACK, LAYERS, DB, RLS, AUDIT, JWT, SESS, RBAC, HTTP, SECRETS, ENV, TEST, CICD, DOCS, AGENT

steps.action: Customize project-specific clusters: edit INV-CICD-001.json (deploy gate specifics), INV-RLS-001.json (tenant model), INV-JWT-001.json (token format), etc.
steps.expected_outcome: Substantive client invariants reflect this project's stack; statement / rationale / verification updated; LAW-XX.YY.Z tags preserved for forensic grep

steps.action: Run `devai spec validate invariants --strict-cnl` to verify both schema-correctness AND CNL discipline (modal verbs in every statement)
steps.expected_outcome: All 15 + 10 DEVAI-meta invariants validate; cnl-warn findings are zero or have known reasons

steps.action: For any inherited rule the client cannot satisfy yet, add an `// inv-override: INV-XX-NNN` annotation in source with `reason / ticket / expires / approver`
steps.expected_outcome: `devai policy check overrides` lists every active override, including expiry; constitutional + hard-fail severity invariants are NOT overridable (override fails)

steps.action: Run `devai spec rtd bundle --strict` to confirm the entire spec-bundle is readiness=ok
steps.expected_outcome: RTM-NNNN persisted; readiness.ok=true; manifest_hash is the citable handle for this spec version
alternative_paths: If a tombstoned rule id is reused, the tombstone-enforcement gate hard-fails (Phase 10.D)
If an invariant's authority anchor (AGENTS.md section) is missing, validate-invariants reports `cannot resolve anchor`

postconditions: Client repo now carries both DEVAI-meta invariants (INV-DEVAI-*) AND substantive client invariants (15 cluster-level)
rtd bundle produces a stable manifest_hash that the client can cite in their ADRs
Any inv-override entries are time-bounded and visible to audit

acceptance_criteria.statement: Client's spec validate-all is green: 25+ invariants, trace clean, glossary clean, all actions claimed.
Every active inv-override carries a future-dated `expires` value; expired overrides are reported as findings (Phase 10.B discipline).
